sn35.145:1.1: Rūpā bhikkhave anattā || yo pi hetu yo pi paccayo rupānam uppādāya so pi anattā || anattasambhūtā bhikkhave rūpā kuto attā bhavissanti || || Saddā || || Gandhā || || Rasā || || Phoṭṭhabbā || || Dhammā anattā || yo pi hetu yo pi paccayo dhammānam uppādāya so pi anattā || anattasambhūtā bhikkhave dhammā kuto attā bhavissanti || || Evam passam || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || Devadahavaggo catuttho ||
sn35.145:2.0: Tassuddānaṃ || || Devadahakhaṇo Saṅgayha || Agayha dve honti Palāsinā || Hetunā pi tayo vuttā || || Duve ajjhatta-bāhirāti || ||
